name: 会话归档
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="5" rx="1.5"/><path d="M5 9v10a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h10a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V9"/><path d="M10 13h4"/></svg>
description: 左栏会话行里的「收起」按钮：把对话从侧边栏收起来，不删任何文件、不申请目录授权，也不保存副本（要看历史全文请用 md-chat 之类的阅读器）。可设 1/7/30 天或永不到期；到期默认只标记提醒，手动确认才删文件。附管理面板：恢复（自动展开所在项目、滚动并闪烁定位）、最近删除记录。
descriptionEn: A "tuck away" button inside each sidebar conversation row: hides the chat without deleting files, without requesting directory access and without keeping a copy (use a reader like md-chat to read history). Optional 1/7/30-day or never expiry; expiry only marks the entry and deletion needs explicit confirmation. Ships a panel to restore (auto-expand, scroll, flash) and to review recently deleted chats.

settings.label: 默认保留天数
settings.hint: 归档时直接使用的天数（点 🗄 立即归档，不再弹窗）；0 表示永不到期。

settings.label: 当前打开的对话也显示归档按钮
settings.labelEn: Show the archive button on the active row

settings.label: 到期自动删除会话文件
settings.labelEn: Delete the session file automatically on expiry
settings.hint: 默认关闭：到期只标记“已到期”，文件不动。开启后也只在已授权会话目录时才删，不会弹授权框。
